mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, req_id, title, description, source, item_kind, priority, status, expect_date, accept_text, version_id, review_note, wsjf_business, wsjf_urgency, wsjf_risk, wsjf_effort, created_by, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id = #{versionId} AND status <> 'rej' ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'plan', 'pass', 'review'), created_at, id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand (id, workspace_id, req_id, title, description, source, item_kind, priority, status, expect_date, accept_text, version_id, review_note, wsjf_business, wsjf_urgency, wsjf_risk, wsjf_effort, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{reqId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{source}, #{itemKind}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{expectDate}, #{acceptText}, #{versionId}, #{reviewNote}, #{wsjfBusiness}, #{wsjfUrgency}, #{wsjfRisk}, #{wsjfEffort}, #{createdBy}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP))
mapper.update: UPDATE demand SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, source = #{source}, item_kind = #{itemKind}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, expect_date = #{expectDate}, accept_text = #{acceptText}, version_id = #{versionId}, review_note = #{reviewNote}, wsjf_business = #{wsjfBusiness}, wsjf_urgency = #{wsjfUrgency}, wsjf_risk = #{wsjfRisk}, wsjf_effort = #{wsjfEffort}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM demand WHERE id = #{id} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
DELETE FROM demand WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND req_id = #{reqId}
DELETE FROM demand_log WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND demand_id = #{demandId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_log (workspace_id, demand_id, action, note, operator) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{demandId}, #{action}, #{note}, #{operator})
mapper.select: SELECT dl.id, dl.demand_id AS demandId, dl.action, dl.note, dl.operator, u.display_name AS operatorName, dl.created_at AS createdAt FROM demand_log dl LEFT JOIN app_user u ON u.id = dl.operator WHERE dl.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND dl.demand_id = #{demandId} ORDER BY dl.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE demand SET version_id = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND version_id IS NOT NULL
